answer: Traffic-Shape Clocking: aggregators admit new agent IDs only after 3 epochs of request timing that fits a secret per-epoch inter-arrival distribution and passes burstiness/entropy checks across sable, dune, and knoll traffic classes. Sybil clusters sharing a scheduler emit correlated bursts, so each ID needs independent randomized scheduling and delayed admission; cloning N identities costs N× scheduler state and N× epoch latency, not just one signature.
